name: tukang-mcp
description: MCP server for AI-native handyman and local services dispatch in Singapore. Enables AI agents to search, match, and dispatch skilled tradespeople (tukang) via WhatsApp.

tools.name: search_handymen
tools.description: Search for available skilled tradespeople near a location with specific skills. Returns handymen sorted by distance, rating, and availability.

parameters.job_type: string (required) — plumbing, electrical, carpentry, aircon, painting, general
parameters.max_distance_km: number (optional) — search radius in km, default 10
parameters.max_results: number (optional) — max results to return, default 5

tools.name: dispatch_job
tools.description: Create a new job and dispatch it to matched handymen via WhatsApp. Handymen receive Accept/Reject buttons. First to accept wins the job atomically.

parameters.urgency: string (optional) — low, normal, urgent. Default: normal
parameters.handyman_ids: array (optional) — specific handyman IDs to dispatch to

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Get current status of a job including all dispatch attempts, acceptance info, and assigned handyman details.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs with optional status filtering. Useful for agent debugging and admin monitoring.

parameters.status: string (optional) — pending, dispatched, accepted, completed, cancelled
parameters.limit: number (optional) — max jobs to return, default 20
